a network constructed by integrating multiple data types, including genotypics, TFBS, and PPI data, is the most predictive of gene expression activity.

a network constructed by integrating genotypically, TFBS, and PPI data can be used to predict causal gene expression regulators, and can also be used to elucidate the mechanisms underlying large-scale changes in gene activity.

the integration and analysis of large-scale functional genomics data, and the application of the resulting networks to the study of gene regulation.
the integration of multiple data types to reconstruct causal gene regulatory networks.
